## Decision recorded: framing & fragmentation across carrier classes

Design record: [`doc/2026-11-09_decision_id5810_carrier_framing.md`](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/main/doc/2026-11-09_decision_id5810_carrier_framing.md) (PR: see linked pull request).

**Decision in one line.** The adapter boundary carries one canonical serialized postcard frame. An adapter adds only the framing its carrier needs and removes it before handing the frame to ID; a frame is never re-encoded (no JSON/base64 variants) and never given carrier-specific message semantics.

| Carrier class | Chosen shape | Exposed to ID |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stream | One length-prefixed canonical frame; incremental reads; no application fragmentation | Reliable ordered bytes; clean EOF between frames = close, EOF mid-frame = truncation |
| Datagram | Whole frame in one datagram when it fits the negotiated/safe payload; otherwise the **existing checked-chunk/reassembly** representation; never IP fragmentation | Loss/duplication/reorder tolerated; frames exposed in completion order |
| Store-and-forward | Opaque whole frame, or checked chunks under the existing transfer identity when constrained; assembled before decode | Any arrival order, duplicates idempotent, no partial delivery, expiry is terminal |

**Rejected:** per-read-as-a-message, reject-oversize-datagrams, IP fragmentation, per-adapter chunk formats, re-encoding for constrained carriers, and inferring ordering/exactly-once from unreliable carriers.

**Invariants implementation must hold:** canonical bytes after deframing/assembly; one frame one decode (only after length/digest validation within the shared 1 MiB frame cap); bounded resources and pre-allocation length checks; chunk identity with idempotent duplicates; arrival order is never order; no accidental reliability promise; expiry is terminal for an assembly; sender obeys carrier-negotiated datagram limits; security stays layered over the fully reconstructed frame.

**Parent #5674:** this record consumes the parent's adapter direction and fills in the per-carrier mapping. It changes **no** frozen parent decision. The envelope layout, chunk metadata encoding, `fragmented` flag semantics and size/extension rules stay with #5674/#5808/#5809; if the parent contract cannot express this shape with the existing checked-chunk representation, that is resolved there before implementation.

**Scope:** does not split further. Adjacent ownership: #5808 (schema/golden vectors), #5809 (version negotiation), #5813 (relay/proxy), #5814 (conformance harness), #5815 (security binding). Implementation timing remains a separate decision.

*Posted by repo-health-code-pilot worker `repo-worker-code` (task 13585).*
